criteria.long_description: The PDF specifies context, roles, objectives, initial conditions, action and resolution procedures, an end condition, and at least one consequential choice in enough detail to support the dry run.

ratings.description: Demonstrated: concrete, internally consistent, and usable
Not demonstrated: missing, contradictory, or too general to use

criteria.long_description: The plan specifies pre-session consent, boundaries, an in-session pause/change/leave procedure, post-session check-in, and a route to withdraw permission before submission.

ratings.description: Not demonstrated: a required procedure is absent or unusable

criteria.long_description: The plan identifies primary and backup recording, file naming, storage, editing, export, each member's responsibilities, and completion dates.

ratings.description: Demonstrated: workflow, owners, and dates are specific
Not demonstrated: responsibilities or production steps remain unspecified

criteria.long_description: The plan identifies expected barriers, concrete responses, a transcript or caption workflow, and at least one feature supporting listener comprehension.

ratings.description: Demonstrated: barriers and implementable responses are connected
Not demonstrated: access is only asserted or omitted

criteria.long_description: The plan states a testable question, evidence to collect, timing, and decisions or revisions that the evidence can inform.

ratings.description: Demonstrated: question, evidence, and decision are testable
Not demonstrated: the dry run lacks a testable question or evidence plan

criteria.long_description: The PDF includes dated milestones, observable definitions of done for recording and submission, and complete relevant AI chatlogs or a no-AI statement.

ratings.description: Demonstrated: completion conditions and appendix are present
Not demonstrated: schedule, completion conditions, or required appendix is absent
